lcc_original: 該隱和妻子同房，妻子就懷孕。生了以諾。該隱建造了一座城；就按他兒子的名、給那城起名叫以諾。
notes: LCC 和 (≈UNV 與) both render H0853 אֶת used prepositionally ('with') in 'Cain knew his wife'; tagged with <WAH0853> normally.
Second {<WAH0853>} kept implicit — direct object marker for 以諾 with no explicit LCC word.
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} kept implicit — copula הָיָה is unexpressed in LCC.
LCC 起名叫 replaces UNV 叫做 for H7121 (קָרָא, 'call/name'); morphology <WTH8799> attaches to the verbal phrase 起名叫.
LCC omits 他 before second instance of 妻子 (his wife) — pronominally implicit from context; H2029 still attaches to 懷孕.
